overview: Galaxy Strike X is a premium 2D space shooter web game playable on both mobile and desktop browsers. Features rich particle effects, dual control schemes, an upgrade shop, leaderboards, and progressive enemy waves.
features: Story Mode (15 waves with bosses) and Endless Survival Mode
4 upgradeable weapons with distinct visual effects
5 enemy types including Mini-Boss and Final Boss with complex AI
Player progression: XP, levels, unlockable ship skins, achievements
Full PC controls (keyboard+mouse) and mobile virtual joystick
Rich particle system: explosions, bullet trails, thruster flames
In-game upgrade shop, coin collection, and power-ups
Global leaderboard with persistent cloud saves
Professional futuristic HUD with health/shield/energy bars
Synthesized audio via Web Audio API
